exceptions.date-range: Range bar intentionally meets both date discs. Reverse demo must stay inside the received disc.
exceptions.calendar-view: Cells must remain separate in both transition directions.
exceptions.reschedule: Event covers its target disc after receipt. Open tray has no tint; enclosed calendar leaf does.
exceptions.alarm-clock: Bell chords, legs and hands intentionally attach. Bell counters still require native review.
exceptions.stopwatch: Tick outer ends join case rim; plunger attaches to stem.
exceptions.countdown-timer: Marker joins the dial rim; remaining-time arc stays inside.
exceptions.world-clock: Globe meridians join its frame. Separate clock dial and moving hands require protected gaps.
exceptions.availability: Busy bars are filled slots; free slot has a real opening.
